about: The PQ half of flagship/security-notice/v1 (docs/architecture-v2/pq-suites.md §14). DRAFT, pending Q01 external review. Generated by tools/security-notice-pq-vectors.ts. Each case gives the verdict of verifySecurityNotice ("ok" or a refusal) with the release PQ pin empty and with the pin naming `pinnedKeyIds`; `authorityKeys` is the ca-track authority. A refusal before the PQ check ("malformed") is the same under both pins.
